specs.title: S09 payment: a payment is invisible and unverifiable outside its own tenant
S10 amendments: an amendment is unlistable and unreviewable outside its tenant
S11 notifications: a student inbox is theirs, and no admin reads across the boundary
S12 review: a cross-tenant review command is refused and mutates nothing
